A closer look

DATABASE CLIENT
01 /

Connect to your databases.

The current MVP includes PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite connections, connection testing, and saved connection settings.

02 /

Find your way around.

Browse schemas, tables, and columns. Preview table data without writing a query for every first look.

03 /

Get to the query.

A multi-statement SQL editor displays query results in a grid. The current MVP limits each result set to its first 1,000 rows.

GET STARTED

Taking shape, one query at a time.

FastBase is in development. This page describes the current MVP scope, rather than a publicly released application.

Development preview

There is no public download or source link yet. Follow FastAGI on GitHub for public project activity.

Explore FastAGI on GitHub

A few useful details.

Can I download FastBase today?

This website does not yet provide a public FastBase download. We will add a release link when a public package is available.

Which databases are in the MVP?

The repository describes PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite support. These are FastBase client capabilities and are separate from FastBuild’s PostgreSQL-only backend.

Is the source public?

The source repository is currently private, and no public open-source license has been verified. We do not label FastBase as open source at this stage.
